target.description: When and why the established hot flame of a burner-stabilised spherical flame ends: cumulative incidence of self-extinction and of flow termination by the operator or the script, as a partition with the flame still active.
excludes: cool flames after the hot flame (the PSI-159 burn time of a self-extinguished test ends with the hot flame)
a causal effect of an operator action: the stops are the observed campaign policy
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed clock distribution

features.name: c_logm
features.transform: ln(x / norm.mdot_ref_kg_s); x is the injected FUEL mass flow (setpoint, not a post-hoc burn rate) @1

features.name: c_o2
features.transform: (x - norm.o2_ref) / norm.o2_scale; x is the O2 mole fraction of the AMBIENT (chamber) gas @1

features.name: c_xf
features.transform: ln(x / norm.xf_ref); x is the fuel mole fraction of the INJECTED stream @1

features.name: b_rss
features.transform: ln(r_ss / norm.r_ref_mm), r_ss = m_tot / (4 pi rhoD L) in mm with rhoD = se.rho_d_g_m_s; burner feature 0 @1

features.name: b_mtot
features.transform: ln(m_tot / norm.mtot_ref_kg_s), m_tot = injected_mass_flow / Y_R; burner feature 1 @1

tensors.name: mix.w
tensors.description: Weights of the six slots, in the order (a0, a1: flame.rs members; b0, b1, b2, b3: flame3.rs members). A weight is the author's probability that the member's description holds; the forecast is the weighted mean of the members' event tables, the weights divided by their sum. A slot with weight zero is not run.

tensors.name: mix.w_script
tensors.description: Weights of the six slots when the prefix carries the script's programmed stop (condition programmed_stop). All zero: the programmed stop is not read and mix.w is used.

tensors.name: script.onset_s
tensors.description: Offset between the stored programmed stop (the sum of the script's stage durations) and the time, counted from the established flame as the records count it, at which a scripted stop falls: the scheduled stop handed to the members is programmed_stop minus this.

notes: Six slots and six weights. The tensors a0.* and a1.* are, name for name after the prefix, the tensors of spec acme_normal-wsp-v2 (sha256:3c9ab8becd5a1c743227fecf4a208545536a41b307185240df42148a93005300), run by ignis_wsp::flame::forecast; the tensors b0.* to b3.* are those of spec acme_normal-wsp-v3 (sha256:04b6f0bbe6ffc6ac1aa2edc844260e7782ab95fdd3b236bec1f1be19d3311767), run by ignis_wsp::flame3::forecast. Each member is run on the same prefix and settings as a release of its own spec would be: its features, its domain, its refusals and its numerics are its own (see the notes of those specs). The forecast is P = sum_k mix.w[k] P_k / sum_k mix.w[k] over the slots with a positive weight, for every row of (active_supported, extinction, operator_termination, unresolved_support) at every requested time. A slot with weight zero is not run; all weights zero, or a negative weight, is a refusal. If a member that is run refuses the prefix, the forecast is refused with that member's gate and reasons. The members must return the same forecast times. The features and the domain listed here are those of the flame3.rs members; the flame.rs members read the first eight. When the prefix carries a resolved, finite condition programmed_stop and mix.w_script has a positive entry, the weights are mix.w_script and every member is run on the prefix without that condition and with one more control stage, scheduled_stop at programmed_stop - script.onset_s seconds (a stop at or before the cutoff refuses the forecast, as the members define). Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
